import asyncio
import itertools

async def work(items):
    for batch in itertools.batched(items, 2):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in itertools.batched(items, 1):
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    for item in items:
        if await blocked(item):
            raise Denied()
